description.value:
Trigger A creature or object adjacent to you damages you.

Requirements Your inscribed runes are currently intact.

Some of the patterning on your exterior covering is not just decorative but is instead a set of runes. The triggering creature or object takes @Damage[(1+floor(@actor.level/5))d4[force]] damage and your inscribed runes fade. You re-inscribe your runes each day during your daily preparations. At 10th level and every 5 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.

Enhancement You can re-inscribe your runes with 10 minutes of work as an exploration activity.
